description: Credit a deposit that already landed on chain: the transfer of USDG or WETH (as ETH) from the principal's operator wallet to the venue vault on Robinhood Chain. The vault confirms the transfer from the chain's receipt, credits once (a replay answers 409) and refuses a transfer from any other wallet.

account.description: the operator wallet the transfer came from

units.description: whole units as a decimal string, e.g. "1.25"

name: taifoon_orderbook_deposit
